sentences.en: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
sentences.zh: 网络活动人士希望与最高领导人会面。

sentences.en: We consider cyber terrorism to pose a serious threat to international security.
sentences.zh: 我们认为网络恐怖主义对国际安全构成严重威胁。

sentences.en: The plausible deniability associated with hacking has ushered in an era of cyber warfare.
sentences.zh: 与黑客攻击相关的合理否认开启了网络战争的时代。
